geneva-jura-balcony-and-lake-sweep.title: Geneva · Jura Balcony and Lake Sweep
geneva-jura-balcony-and-lake-sweep.slogan: Jura curves and a lake return with big views.
geneva-jura-balcony-and-lake-sweep.story: Jura curves and a lake return with big views. A 111 km loop that starts and ends near Gex, about 2 h 07 of riding. On the way it passes Jura balcony road, Nyon lakeside and La Dôle view area. The highest point is about 950 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.narrative: For 21 km this is Jura Crest Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 44 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
